# `get_3p_pa_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the three-point polar-alignment setting.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit and 32-bit builds, by command-socket invocation, which always writes shared diagnostics); the handler itself is a probable pure getter (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xba2e0, Get3PPaSetting @0x120360 (64-bit build) |

Returns whether three-point alignment is selected and the stored rotation angle.

Side effects: Copies a small stored setting; only the shared request/reply diagnostics are written.

## Example

Request, query:

```json
{"id":111,"method":"get_3p_pa_setting"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_3p_pa_setting","result":{"is_pa_3p":true,"rotate_angle":30},"code":0,"id":111}
```
